title: Aesthetic judgement
learning_outcomes: Explain formal qualities in the context of aesthetic judgement.
Compare and distinguish cultural context in the context of aesthetic judgement.
Apply aesthetic reasoning in the context of aesthetic judgement.
Evaluate and justify decisions about curation in the context of aesthetic judgement.

lessons.title: Formal qualities
lessons.outcome: Explain formal qualities in the context of aesthetic judgement.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving formal qualities; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to curatorial portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain formal qualities from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of formal qualities; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Cultural context
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish cultural context in the context of aesthetic judgement.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving cultural context; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to curatorial portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain cultural context from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of cultural context; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Aesthetic reasoning
lessons.outcome: Apply aesthetic reasoning in the context of aesthetic judgement.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving aesthetic reasoning; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to curatorial portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain aesthetic reasoning from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of aesthetic reasoning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Curation
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about curation in the context of aesthetic judgement.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving curation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to curatorial portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain curation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of curation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of formal qualities; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of cultural context; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of aesthetic reasoning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of curation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practising artist or arts educator; cultural expertise where relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
